text_block_list.text:
As one event at a fan meet-and-greet, 
Win Variation, who had trained in ballet, 
was going to take the stage--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: One, two...! One, two...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Ah, I'm fine. 
I got to run through it properly at rehearsal...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm closing out today's event, after all. 
I'll do my best...!
choice_data_list: Glad to hear it. But aren't you nervous?
Glad to hear it. But aren't you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......That's fine too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I should probably start getting ready. 
I'll... go change.

How could I loosen Win Variation up? 
I was still turning it over when I went 
to fetch her from the dressing room--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...... 
......Phew.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: --...All right.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. 
I'm ready.

Win Variation's eyes were stronger than before. 
That light brought something back to me--

It was back when we were deciding on her racing outfit. 
We'd watched a DVD of a ballet 
her father had danced the lead in--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It has to be this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. For my racing outfit, 
I want the motif to be ballet!
choice_data_list: Is that because of your father?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Watching that just now, I realized it. 
--This really is where I started.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I danced the lead at a recital 
at my ballet school, and my mind went completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In front of everyone, I lost track of how 
a lead was supposed to carry herself...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
From here on... even in racing, the pressure 
might make me lose sight of myself again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
But... the lead I want to become 
is my father, the way I saw him as a child.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So I'll carve it into my racing outfit. 
The origin of what I admire, as a marker to return to.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even when the pressure feels like it will crush me, 
I'll remember the lead I want to be, and picture her...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: So that I never lose my way again--...!

--...The Win Variation standing here now 
has the very same eyes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's about time we moved, isn't it. 
Let's go, Trainer.

Just before her turn. Win Variation waits 
in the wings. And all the while, she--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I'm more than ready. 
Because I can see it now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A stage shining just like the one 
my father stood on--!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
--And now, let's bring her out! 
Win Variation, if you please!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This is it...! 
All right, I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This is it...! 
All right, I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(......Today, I'm the lead. 
So I'm going to show them.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: But--... please watch me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(......Today, I'm the lead. 
So I'm going to show them.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The finest performance--one worthy of this costume!)
(Whoaaaa...!!)

Win Variation's performance drew 
cheers from all across the audience.
